text: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge is an independent Norwegian savings bank (sparebank). Sparebankstiftelsen Nord-Norge, a foundation set up in 2011, holds the bank's equity certificates (egenkapitalbevis) with the charter purpose of exercising long-term and stable ownership in the bank.
short: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge is a savings bank whose equity certificates are held by Sparebankstiftelsen Nord-Norge.
